title: arcade duplex
content: I have dreamed a few times about a very specific arcade-like building. Half of the building is a housing situation with bedrooms and a kitchen. The other half is a large arcade with bright green walls. The residents of the building seem to work at the arcade. Some of the games/machines are nonfunctional with large beige sheets thrown over them. There are rooms for karaoke and sometimes it feels like the set of a game show? From what I can remember, the building is located in the middle of nowhere off of a highway exit. I usually don't think too much of my dreams but this specific place has come up more than once and I'm wondering if anyone else dreams of this place!
